For the places where the bones and joints turn, because the places where the bones and joints are very long are easy to shake, if one uses only the bamboo curtain, one fears that the force of firmness is insufficient; therefore one must add this to encircle it, so that the bone seams fit together firmly. [Figure: Fir fence and bamboo curtain 7]
[Figure: Diagram of the use of the bamboo curtain and fir fence 8]
<ins>Knee-embracing (抱膝)</ins> (Instrument 10) The knee-embracing is a bamboo ring with four legs. Make a ring of bamboo strips, a little larger than the kneecap; then use four bamboo strips, bind them tightly onto the ring with hemp thread, forming the shape of four legs, and wind white cloth strips all around the bamboo ring and the four legs.
